title: How much is it?
subtitle: A birthday present for Rose — prices, how much and how many
canDo: I can ask and say prices.
I can use how much and how many.
I can buy something in a shop.
teacherNotes: Fiyat okuma: $14.99 = fourteen ninety-nine (günlük dil) ya da fourteen dollars and ninety-nine cents. İkisini de tanısınlar.
How many + sayılabilir çoğul, How much + sayılamaz; ayrıca fiyat sorusu: How much is it? Arapçadaki "كم / بكم" ikisini de karşılar; farkı özellikle gösterin.
Menü okuma metnini sunum modunda açıp "How much is a tea?" gibi hızlı sorularla oyun yapın.
Rol yapma: dükkân. Öğrenciler sırayla satıcı ve müşteri olsun; ekranda basit bir fiyat listesi gösterin.

sections.title: Grammar: how much and how many
look: **How much are** the cards? — **They're** three dollars each.

head: Question
Answer
rows: How many eggs do you want?
How much milk do you want?

rules: Prices: **How much is** + one thing? · **How much are** + two or more?
**How much** + uncountable: How much **milk**? How much **money**?
Say prices: $6.50 = six dollars fifty / six fifty
examples: How much is a coffee? — It's $2.50.
How much are the apples? — They're a dollar each.
How much water do you drink?

support.tr: Fiyat sormak için How much is …? (tek şey) ve How much are …? (birden fazla) kullanılır. Miktar sorarken: sayılabilir çoğul isimlerle How many (How many eggs? = Kaç yumurta?), sayılamayan isimlerle How much (How much milk? = Ne kadar süt?).
support.ar: للسؤال عن السعر نقول: How much is …? (للمفرد) و How much are …? (للجمع) = بكم …؟ وللسؤال عن الكمّية: How many مع الجمع المعدود (How many eggs? = كم بيضة؟)، و How much مع غير المعدود (How much milk? = كم من الحليب؟). في العربية «كم» واحدة للحالتين، أما في الإنجليزية فهناك كلمتان.

tr.note: Birden fazla şeyin fiyatını sorarken is değil are; sayılabilir isimlerle much değil many.
wrong: How much eggs do you want?
right: How many eggs do you want?

ar.note: «كم» العربية لها ترجمتان: How many للمعدود و How much لغير المعدود وللسعر.
wrong: How much apples do you want?
right: How many apples do you want?
